correctness.rationale: For f(X)=X^p-X-1, Frobenius orbit size p proves irreducibility. Touchard plus the nondegenerate trace pairing gives Bell term trace representation with nonzero coefficient. Under the exact period hypothesis, the root has multiplicative order N_p; gcd(N_p,p−1)=1 gives one projective representative per index. For any nonzero h, rho^h is not in F_p and hence has degree p, so the ℓ trace functionals are independent for ℓ≤p. Their codimension-ℓ kernel has (p^(p−ℓ)−1)/(p−1) projective points. Finite checks at p=2,3,5 corroborate, but are not the proof.

value.rationale: For a classical combinatorial sequence, the exact multi-point zero-index incidence across every nonzero spacing is a complete natural additive invariant; it sharply classifies maximal (p−1)-term zeros and forbids p-term zeros, even for proper-divisor spacings. The nonunit-spaced case cannot be obtained by simply permuting the known consecutive block, and higher-order counts are not forced by two-point Singer difference set incidence alone.
